theme.title: Twin Towers rise
theme.subtitle: San Antonio Spurs, 1998–99
theme.recap: The Spurs overcame a difficult lockout-season start and rode Duncan and Robinson to the franchise's first championship.

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Tim Duncan average in the 1999 Finals?
questions.note: 27.4 points per game while winning Finals MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while averaging 27.4 points and fourteen rebounds with 2.4 assists and 2.2 blocks in the Finals

funFacts.text: Duncan was in his second NBA season alongside David Robinson in the Twin Towers pairing.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1998–99 season was the second season of the "Twin Towers" pairing

funFacts.text: San Antonio drafted Duncan after an injury-hit season and a fortunate draft lottery.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs earned this draft pick through the draft lottery due to a 62-loss 1996–97 season

funFacts.text: The Knicks were an eighth seed when they reached the Finals, an extraordinary playoff run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Knicks barely qualified for the playoffs and received the eighth and final seed

questions.prompt: After a slow start, how many of their final 36 games did the 1999 Spurs win?
questions.context: San Antonio · lockout season · closing stretch

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Spurs recovered from a 6–8 start to the season to win 31 of their last 36 games

funFacts.text: Steve Kerr joined the Spurs from the championship Bulls before this season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: acquired three-point specialist Steve Kerr from the Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: San Antonio added two veteran free agents, Mario Elie and Jerome Kersey, to its rotation.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: signed free agents Mario Elie, and Jerome Kersey

funFacts.text: The Spurs put together several separate winning streaks during a packed spring schedule.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posted a nine-game winning streak in March afterwards, posted a six-game winning streak

questions.prompt: What did David Robinson average in rebounds in the 1999 Finals?
questions.note: 11.8 rebounds a night during San Antonio's first championship.

funFacts.text: Robinson partnered with Tim Duncan in their second season as the Twin Towers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 1998–99 season was the second season of the "Twin Towers" pairing

funFacts.text: Robinson also finished in the top group of regular-season MVP voting that year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: while Robinson finished in twelfth place

funFacts.text: The Spurs swept both the Lakers and Portland on their way to the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeating the Los Angeles Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Avery Johnson average in the 1999 Finals?
questions.note: 7.2 assists per game, plus a defining Finals shot.

funFacts.text: Johnson delivered the series-winning shot in Game 5 as the Spurs won their first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Avery Johnson hit the game-winner

funFacts.text: Johnson led San Antonio with nine assists in the deciding game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Asts: Avery Johnson 9

funFacts.text: Johnson scored 9.2 points per game while handling the Spurs' offense during the Finals.

questions.prompt: What was San Antonio's total home attendance in the shortened 1998–99 season?
questions.note: 527,357 attended Spurs home games despite the shorter schedule.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: an attendance of 527,357 at the Alamodome during the regular season

funFacts.text: The Spurs ranked second in home attendance during the season, trailing only Chicago.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs finished second in the NBA in home-game attendance behind the Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: The season ended with the first NBA championship in San Antonio franchise history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs defeated the Knicks in five games to win their first NBA championship.

funFacts.text: The entire league had to play a compressed calendar after the lockout delayed opening night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Due to a lockout, the regular season began on February 5, 1999
